description: PR 876 comments 2 and overlapping 4, implemented after explicit user approval. ZAQ DeliveryError is a data-only struct with original reason, safe message, stage and delivery certainty. DeliveryFiles owns shared preparation-error mapping. Channels.Api owns fallback: preparation failures can send answer plus safe detail without attachments; uncertain transport can only update an existing placeholder through existing upsert callback. SMTP errors never automatically resend. Unknown legacy errors do not trigger fallback. Original reason retained internally and omitted from struct inspection. Action reuse: existing DeliveryFiles, Materialization, DecodeBase64 Action, bridge send/upsert callbacks, API orchestration and confirmation path reused; no new Action/tool/framework. User approved error-shape migration, no-resend policy and email revocation preparation notice. Unit/property/integration regressions and docs updated. Final mix q passed; combined bridge/API/journey run 458 passed (6 properties), consumer/preparation run 123 passed (4 properties). No commit/push/PR resolution authorized.
